title: A Business Tax-Compliance Checklist for Nepal (Statutory Deadlines)
metaDescription: A complete tax calendar and compliance checklist for Nepalese businesses. Never miss monthly VAT returns, advance tax installments, or annual filing deadlines.
h1: A Business Tax-Compliance Checklist for Nepal
directAnswer: A business tax compliance checklist in Nepal requires observing statutory filing cycles: monthly VAT returns (D-01) and withholding tax (TDS) payments by the 25th of every Nepali month; three advance income tax installments due by Poush end (40%), Chaitra end (70%), and Ashad end (100%); and annual corporate tax return filing (D-03) by Poush 31.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Research Desk

sections.h2: The Annual Nepalese Statutory Tax Calendar
sections.contentHtml:
Mark these non-negotiable statutory tax milestones in your corporate calendar to avoid automated compounding fines:

DeadlineStatutory ObligationGoverning Rule
25th of Every Nepali MonthDeposit prior month's Withholding Tax (TDS) & file monthly VAT return (D-01)VAT Act 2052 Sec 18
End of Poush1st Advance Income Tax Installment (Minimum 40% of estimated annual tax)Income Tax Act Sec 94
End of Poush (Poush 31)Annual Tax Return (D-03) filing deadline for previous fiscal yearIncome Tax Act Sec 96
End of Chaitra2nd Advance Income Tax Installment (Minimum 70% of estimated annual tax)Income Tax Act Sec 94
End of Ashad (Ashad 31)3rd Advance Income Tax Installment (100% of estimated annual tax) & Fiscal Year CloseIncome Tax Act Sec 94

Failing to deposit mandatory advance tax installments triggers interest penalties under Section 118 of the Income Tax Act at standard statutory rates from the due date until final settlement. Explore our corporate tax planning solutions to model your advance installments accurately.

faqs.question: What if our business has zero turnover in a specific month?
faqs.answer: You must still submit a 'Zero VAT Return' (Sunya D-01) on the IRD portal by the 25th. Failing to submit a zero return incurs the standard NPR 1,000 late penalty.
